propositions: The gate matches field names globally as bare attribute names rather than resolving reads to their owning dataclass, causing same-named fields on unrelated configs to satisfy the check spuriously
A field is flagged as read only when its bare name appears anywhere in src/rebar, not when the field's declaring class instance is actually read

CodeHealthConfig.enabled had zero read sites but passed the gate because .enabled was read on unrelated configs (UiConfig.enabled, McpConfig.auth_enabled, etc.), while the uniquely-named CodeHealthConfig.analyzers correctly tripped the gate
The fix must resolve each read's receiver to the dataclass that declares the field, and report newly-flagged fields with accurate read-via markers rather than silently exempting them

Four fields are newly flagged by the corrected gate (McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, JiraConfig.allow_insecure), each with a real consumer but no attribute read the resolver can find
The gate must preserve existing negative fixtures (ReconcilerConfig.lock_lease_secs, VerifyConfig.require_plan_review_for_close trio) that are read via string keys and already carry read-via markers
